take_homes: Default to one agent. Split only for different access, different dialect or different stance, and ask whether one prompt could do the same.
Failures happen at the handoffs between agents, such as a conflicting number silently dropped. Check the seams.
The audit checks how the agents handed work over, not whether the final briefing is true.

monday.move: Run the crux exercise on one real problem, using our wiki and docs for the retrievers, to see if the answer beats what my team already knows
monday.who: me, alone, maybe one analyst to judge the result
monday.when: an hour on Tuesday if the steering group is cancelled
monday.stop_condition: The briefing says nothing my team could not have told me, or it gives a confident claim I cannot verify
monday.blocker: Calendar, and my doubt that it is worth the hour

misconception.why: This did not read like the last programmes. It told me to use fewer agents, admitted the output cannot be verified, and gave tests I can run myself. I am not convinced it will not blow over, but I no longer file it with agile and OKRs.

one_line: Less hype than I expected. It tells you to use one agent unless you have a reason, and admits it can't tell you whether the answer is right.
